description_summary: Native Android client for the live ForgeHouse 50 web app (forgehouse50.pages.dev, Cloudflare Pages+Workers+D1). Church NT 50-reading-day programme: per-user schedules (Tue/Fri excluded), VerseWell scripture text+audio, notes, one-attempt proportional quiz, points/badges, confidence-weighted leaderboard + final results, admin dashboard, Brevo OTP email auth. Same backend, same API routes as the web app at github.com/vjumbo264/forgehouse50.

backend.auth: email/password signup -> 6-digit OTP via Brevo -> verify -> fh50_session cookie (HttpOnly, 30d). Android client stores token in EncryptedSharedPreferences and sends it as Cookie header fh50_session=<token>.
backend.key_rules: Quiz: ONE attempt, no gate, no timer, proportional points (score/total)*5. Completion: POST /api/read/complete (sequential days, max 1 day read-ahead). Leaderboard eligibility: elapsed_days>=3 on user's own calendar; overall uses damped score (raw_avg*elapsed)/(elapsed+7). Admin accounts cannot participate. Translations served by VerseWell mirror only.

tasks.title: ISSUE 1: Audit and diagnose root cause of stale/zero/null flashing across all screens and widget
tasks.notes: DONE: Audited data flow across Home, Progress, Leaderboard, Profile, Notes, Read, ReadSession, Quiz, Admin, and Widget. Root causes identified: (1) Jetpack Compose screens initialized state with mutableStateOf(null) and only fetched or read prefs inside LaunchedEffect (which runs after frame 1 composition), causing initial frame to display zero points, 0/50 days, 0 streak, and default buttons; (2) SharedPreferences caching was patchy and uncoordinated — me profile, notes count, day details, and plan were not cached for synchronous access; (3) WidgetRefreshWorker wiped out valid widget state on network failures by writing default blank State(day=0); (4) HomeScreen background refresh never pushed fresh snapshots directly into WidgetStateStore. Resolution: centralized LocalCacheStore with synchronous in-memory/SharedPreferences getters called directly during composition before frame 1 renders, plus bidirectional widget synchronization.

tasks.title: ISSUE 1: Implement synchronous LocalCacheStore and hydrate all screens + widget immediately on frame 1
tasks.notes: DONE: Built LocalCacheStore (com.forgebuild.forgehouse50.data.local.LocalCacheStore) providing synchronous getToday(), getMe(), getProgress(), getDay(d), getNotes(), getLeaderboard(cat), getQuiz(d), getAdminStats(), getAdminProgramme(), getAdminParticipants(), and resolvePlan(). Integrated into Repository as repo.cache. Updated HomeScreen, ProgressScreen, LeaderboardScreen, ProfileScreen, NotesScreens, ReadScreen, ReadSessionScreen, QuizScreen, and AdminScreen to initialize state directly from cache on frame 1. Background refresh persists updates and smoothly reconciles. WidgetRefreshWorker falls back to LocalCacheStore on network error and never overwrites with blank defaults; LocalCacheStore.syncWidget() immediately updates WidgetStateStore whenever app refreshes data.

tasks.title: ISSUE 2: Fix Nunito variable font hairline weight with explicit FontVariation.Settings
tasks.notes: DONE: Root-caused hairline thin body font reported twice: Nunito variable font TTF (nunito.ttf) has ExtraLight (wght=200) as its default master axis. Without explicit variation settings, Android font loader fell back to the 200 default master regardless of Compose FontWeight. Fixed in ui/AppTheme.kt by binding FontVariation.Settings(FontVariation.weight(w)) for Normal (400), Medium (500), SemiBold (600), and Bold (700) and configuring AppTypography across all 15 M3 roles (bodyLarge SemiBold 600, bodyMedium/bodySmall Medium 500, titles/headlines SemiBold/Bold). Body text is now deeply legible, confident, and premium.
